name: zsnd_cd_get_track_count
description: zSndCd::GetTrackCount returns the cached CD track count only when the CD-ready flag is set.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this getter; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zSound CD source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja evidence for 0x4a2930 validates masking the ready flag and returning either the cached track count or zero.
The native smoke verifies both not-ready zero and ready cached-count behavior.
